An exceptional rank given on an objective, mission, or level in a game. Typically the highest achievable such rank.
A ranking above A in various situations, including tierlists.
Of exceptional quality in its class.
A trap in a waste pipe in the shape of the letter S, generally used where a drain line rises from the floor.
The S-shaped twist of yarn spun in a counterclockwise direction.
A Sino-Tibetan language spoken in Myanmar and Thailand by the S'gaw people.
